units: Num. R. s. 16 ונקרא אשכול … לִכְרוֹת וכ׳ and he (Abraham’s ally) was named Eshkol (Cluster), on account of the cluster of grapes which the Israelites were destined to cut in his home.—Esp. to cut genitals, mutilate.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 33b:16">Bekh. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>נותק אחר כּוֹרֵת</he>, v. <cite ref="N01387"><he>נָתַק</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="K01133"><he>כָּרוּת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 33b:16">Ib.</cite>; a. fr.—<he>כְּ׳ שפכה</he> one that is mutilated at his membrum, v. <cite ref="U01764"><he>שָׁפַךְ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: [to draw a circle, place outside, cmp. meanings of חרם, ברי,] to cut off, excommunicate, v. כָּרֵת.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:1:2">Y. Bicc. II, beg. 64ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:5:2">Y. Snh. XI, 30ᵇ</cite> <he>צא … עונשין וכוֹרְתִים</he> deduct twenty years up to which age the divine court neither punishes nor decrees excision.

<cite ref="Gittin 21b:9">Gitt. 21ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 24b:6">Succ. 24ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:3">Deut. XXIV, 3</cite>) <he>ספר כּוֹרְתָהּ וכ׳</he> the delivery of the deed divorces her and nothing else does.

Ib. דבר הכּוֹרֵת בינו לבינה something (a condition) which (if fulfilled) severs definitely the connection between him and her (e.g. a condition that she will drink no wine for the next thirty days, after the lapse of which time the letter of divorce takes its effect retroactively, opp. to a condition that she will abstain from wine all the rest of her life in which case the letter of divorce cannot take effect).—Part. pass. כָּרוּת definite.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:3:5">Y. Gitt. VII, 48ᵈ</cite> <he>כגט כ׳ הוא</he> it is like a final divorce (taking effect immediately); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:8:2">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᶜ</cite> top <he>כ׳ הוא</he>.

Y. Gitt. III, 44ᵈ top; IX, 50ᵇ bot. זה כ׳ לשמה ווה כ׳ לשמה (not זו) this letter was definitely made out for this woman, and so was the other for the other woman. Ib. III, beg. 44ᶜ אלא שלא הי׳ לה כ׳ … ראשונה (strike out לה); a. fr.—3) to decide, make final.

Ber. 4ᵃ; Snh. 16ᵇ (ref. to כְּרֵתִי as a symbolical name for the Urim and Tummim, or for the Sanhedrin) שכּוֹרְתִים את דבריהם they give definite and precise decisions; Midr. Till. to Ps. III כּוֹרְתֵי כריתות, v. כְּרִיתָה; a. e.—כ׳ בְּרִית (v. בְּרִית) to covenant, make a firm promise.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:22">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>כָּרַתָּ ב׳ עם וכ׳</he> thou hast promised to Noah that thou wilt not destroy his descendants; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 76:8">Yalk. Gen. 76</cite> <cite ref="K01283"><he>כָּרַתָּה</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="K01133"><he>כָּרוּת</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="K01115"><he>כְּרוּתָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 18a">M. Kat. 18ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ברית כ׳ לשפתים</he>, v. <cite ref="B01282"><he>בְּרִית</he></cite>.

R. Hash. 17ᵇ ב׳ כ׳ לי״ג מדזת וכ׳ there is a solemn insurance given that the invocation of the thirteen divine attributes (Ex. XXXIV, 6, sq.) will never be without effect (ref. to Ex. XXXIV, 10).—Trnsf. ב׳ כ׳ it is a necessity, unavoidable.
<cite ref="Niddah 58b">Nidd. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ כ׳ לו שכל וכ׳</he> whoever crushes it cannot help smelling it.
Yeb. VIII, 2 (expl. כרות שפכה, Deut. XXIII, 2) כל שנ׳ הגיד when the membrum is mutilated. Ib. 75ᵇ נִכְרְתוּ ביצים when the testicles are cut out; a. fr.—2) to be covenanted.
<cite ref="Sotah 37b:6">Sot. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא נִכְרְתוּ עליה וכ׳</he> upon which were not closed forty eight covenants; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:11">Tosef. ib. VIII, 11</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be cut off, destroyed. Y. Peah I, 15ᵈ bot. (ref. to Num. XV, 31) מלמד שהנפש נִכְרָתָה ועונה בה which intimates that (the idolater’s) soul is cut off (through premature death, כָּרֵת), while her guilt remains with her (unexpiated by death); Snh. 64ᵇ (ref. to the emphasized expression הכרת תכ׳, Num. l. c.) הִכָּרֵת בעו״הז וכ׳ hiccareth refers to this world &c.; a. fr.—Verbal noun הִיכָּרֵת, v. כָּרֵת.
to destroy, exterminate. Tanḥ. R’eh 7 והַכְרִיתֵם and exterminate them. Ib. כשיַכְרִית וכ׳ when the Lord … shall have destroyed …, you will enter.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 4:5">Tosef. Snh. IV, 5</cite> <he>להַכְרִית זרעו וכ׳</he> to exterminate the seed of Amalek; a. fr.

<cite ref="Arakhin 15b:56">Arakh. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>שכבר כֵּרְתוֹ וכ׳</he> for David has doomed him &c. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 12:4">Ps. XII, 4</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 559:1">Yalk. Lev. 559</cite>.
